category: backup storage / SFTP box (RAID-6, Enterprise HDD)

free_tier.stated: 250 GB $3/mo · 500 GB $4/mo · 1 TB $6/mo · 2 TB $11/mo. Germany (Falkenstein) and Finland (Helsinki) sold as separate product groups.

egress.terms: "Unmetered Traffic" with "1 GBit/s" port, on both the DE and FI product pages. This is the cleanest egress term among the records read — a port speed with no counter and no published fair-use threshold.

tooling: rsync/Borg/restic over SSH. No S3, no WebDAV.
chaining: Archive/backup leg only. No object API means it cannot serve the hot set or back a Cloudflare origin directly.
limits_note: No WebDAV, no S3. Capacity ladder stops at 2 TB per box on the page — for 20 TB you would need ten boxes, which is operationally ugly even if the per-TB price holds.
reliability_note: Small host (NetDynamics LLC), advertises 256 GB RAM Xeon E5-1650v3 storage nodes with RAID-6 and unmetered 1 Gbit/s.

evidence.proved: "Please check our Storage plans: ... and use the coupon code: LET50% to get a recurring annual 50% discount" (NetDynamics24 Host Rep account)

price_per_tb_month: List: $6.00/TB/mo at 1 TB, $5.50/TB/mo at 2 TB. With LET50% on annual: 1 TB = $30/yr = $2.50/TB/mo; 2 TB = $55/yr = $2.29/TB/mo. at 5 TB: three 2 TB boxes = $2.29/TB/mo. at 20 TB: same $2.29/TB/mo but requires ten boxes. Unmetered 1 Gbit/s is the reason to care.
